about: U.S. House races in New York districts touching New York City, general elections 1898-1998 plus NYC special elections listed on the same pages. Source: English Wikipedia "{YEAR} United States House of Representatives elections" pages (New York section and Special elections section). Percentages as printed there; vote counts are not given on those pages and are null. "p" lists party labels as printed in parentheses (abbreviations Con, Lib, Rep., Prog., Proh, Ind. League and linked abbreviations expanded to full party names). Wikipedia generally lists one party per candidate, so fusion/cross-endorsement lines are often not shown. District 0 = at-large (vf = number of at-large seats filled). Election date for general elections = first Tuesday after the first Monday of November.
